en: Zaynab bint Ahmad ibn Abd al-Rahim ibn al-Husayn
tr: Zeyneb bt. Ahmed b. Abdürrahîm b. el-Hüseyin
ar: زينب بنت أحمد بن عبد الرحيم بن الحسين

description.tr: Memlük döneminin en etkili kadın hadis âlimlerinden — öğrencisi İbn Hacer el-Askalânî tüm zamanların en büyük hadis âlimi oldu || Kadın hadis âlimleri Memlük Dımaşk ve Kahire'sinde dikkate değer biçimde yaygındı. || [Tarih notu] Jonathan Berkey, Asma Sayeed ve Mohammad Akram Nadwi bu dönemde yüzlerce kadın hadis âlimini belgelemiştir.
description.en: One of the most influential female hadith scholars of the Mamluk era — her student Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani became the greatest hadith scholar of all time || Women hadith scholars were remarkably common in Mamluk Damascus and Cairo. Zaynab held chains of transmission (isnad) that male scholars sought out precisely because her chains were shorter and more authoritative. || [Historiographical note] Jonathan Berkey, Asma Sayeed, and Mohammad Akram Nadwi have documented hundreds of female hadith scholars in this period. Zaynab represents a much larger tradition.
description.ar: من أكثر عالمات الحديث تأثيراً في العصر المملوكي || كانت عالمات الحديث شائعات بشكل لافت في دمشق والقاهرة المملوكيتين
